title: skywire message specification
description: The input to wiregen: one message, its members in tag order. Mirrors Specification in src/lib/skywireproto/specification.proto, read as protobuf JSON, plus the checks wiregen makes before generating.

$schema.description: This schema, for editors. wiregen ignores it.

members.description: The members, keyed by tag. Tags order the members on the wire and are their protobuf field numbers: 1 to 536870911, but not 19000-19999.

includes.description: Extra includes or imports for the generated code: a path, <path> or "path". The lang file's own come first; a nested message's are added without listing it here.

fileName.description: A plain file name, no directories. {classname} and {classname_snake} stand for the class name as is and in snake_case.

stringValues.description: Named settings for the message. Other keys are allowed and ignored.

classname.description: The message's class (struct, type) name. A nested message's spec is <classname>.json.

namespace.description: Namespace, package or module: identifiers joined by '.' or '::'. wiregen --namespace overrides it.

bitorder.description: Where a storage unit's first bitfield goes: lsb (low bits, the default) or msb (high bits).

outputheaderfilename.description: Header file name, instead of the lang file's.

outputimplfilename.description: Implementation file name, instead of the lang file's.

outputtestfilename.description: Unit test file name (--generate_tests), instead of the lang file's.

outputrelayfilename.description: Relay file name (--generate_relay), instead of the lang file's.

language.description: Ignored, with a warning: the language comes from the lang file, so one spec serves every language.

nativeTypes.description: Used by lang files; ignored in a message specification.

type.description: A native type, string (a fixed-length char array), or the classname of another message in the same namespace.

name.description: The member's name, unique in the message.

endian.description: Byte order on the wire: 0 little-endian (the default), 1 big-endian, 2 the host's. No effect on 8-bit types or nested messages.

length.description: A string's length in bytes, at least 1.

bits.description: Makes an integer member a bitfield this many bits wide (1 to the type's width), packed with its neighbours.
